purpose: Weight-only (A16) PTQ baselines on Fast-WAM-IDM: GPTQ, QuIP#, QTIP, GPTVQ at 3 and 2 bits; LIBERO-Plus 280 closed loop on the BF16 condition-cache + CUDA-Graph runtime with dequantized dense BF16 weights
budget_rule: total stored bits per weight ~= bits; all side information (scales, zero points, codebooks, sign vectors, padding) counted in bits_total; no fine-tuning for any method

hessian.definition: mean x x^T of the BF16 inputs of each of the 614 target Linears over every call of the 80 C80 queries (case 2000-2079, sampler seed index 0), original coordinates, FP32
hessian.source: BF16 model for every method (no sequential re-collection on quantized layers)

t5_cache.what: T5 prompt embeddings (encode_prompt output) for the 280 panel instructions and the case-2000 anchor prompt, computed once on an A100 by the full BF16 model; closed-loop workers load the model with load_text_encoder=false and serve encode_prompt from this cache
t5_cache.check: each prompt encoded twice and must be bitwise equal; every loop worker reproduces the full-T5 BF16 case-2000 action/future bitwise from the cache before installing quantized weights

closed_loop.runtime: BF16 F.linear on dequantized BF16 weights + query condition cache + three CUDA Graph regions (the bf16_cache_graph mode of job 26028322, 541 ms/call)
closed_loop.startup_check: case-2000 eager vs cache+Graph action/future bitwise equal with the arm's weights
closed_loop.panel: frozen 280-variant LIBERO-Plus manifest, seeds/settling/caps/replans identical to fastwam-plus-engine-eval-20261027
